CHAPTER 6 · ITEM 01 / 12

Price ceilings and floors

Binding controls有約束力的管制

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Identify a binding price ceiling below equilibrium and a binding price floor above equilibrium; recognize when a control has no effect and why.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

價格上限在均衡價以下才具約束力；價格下限在均衡價以上才具約束力。若原均衡仍合法，市場可留在原均衡。

A ceiling is a legal maximum and binds below the free-market equilibrium price. A floor is a legal minimum and binds above equilibrium. A control on the other side of equilibrium leaves the equilibrium available.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：P*=100. A ceiling of 90 binds; a floor of 90 does not. 同樣九十元，上限與下限效果不同。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Equilibrium price is $20. Which control binds? 均衡價二十元，何者具約束力？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
